description: Global tenant query filter disabled - the query returns every tenant's rows unless a manual TenantId predicate is added
Raw SQL bypasses HasQueryFilter - confirm the SQL itself filters by TenantId/CompanyId
Tenant id read from a request shape - it must come from the token claim/context, never from input
Tenant id exposed on a bound request DTO - client can set another tenant's id
Cache access - confirm the key includes the tenant id, else one tenant is served another's cached value
File/blob path - confirm the path contains a tenant segment so paths are not guessable across tenants
Background job - it has no HttpContext, so the tenant filter has no context; confirm it sets/loops tenant explicitly
